about_short_description.short_description: DIGGIPACKS is a cloud fulfillment & last-mile aggregator servicing the e-commerce and retailers in the market.

product.name: E-commerce Fulfillment Services
product.description: Storage, order processing, packaging, and shipping services for e-commerce stores using smart warehouses in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Local Delivery and Shipping Solutions
product.description: Fast local delivery from strategically located warehouses with flexible same-day or next-day options and real-time shipment tracking.

product.name: Logistics Automation and Transportation Management
product.description: Automated logistics systems for transport, shipping, and delivery with real-time tracking, carrier selection, and operational reporting.

product.name: Integrated Technology and Platform Integration
product.description: API-driven integration connecting e-commerce platforms with inventory, order management, barcode generation, and reporting systems.

product.name: Wholesale Storage and Fulfillment Services
product.description: Storage and order fulfillment for bulk shipments and pallets, including B2B order processing and delivery to retail branches or points of sale.

product.name: Returns Management and Reverse Logistics
product.description: Automated system for handling product returns, inspection, restocking, and processing according to store policies.
